ratings.notes: Solid core pathways (ACE2→AGTR1→F3, IL6→F3, F12→KLKB1). PMID citations plausible but not all verifiable. Misses TMPRSS2, NRP1, PADI4 nodes.
Adds PADI4/NETosis node, good structure. Overlaps heavily with A. PMID citations plausible but unverified. Slightly better organized than A.
Adds TLR7→IL6→SERPINE1 and BDKRB2→PLAT paths. Testable hypotheses add value. PMID citations same as others, unverified. Good breadth.
Most comprehensive: adds TMPRSS2→PAR2→F3, NRP1→VEGFA→VWF, NLRP3→IL6, STAT1→CXCL10→THBD. Explicitly flags speculative links. Best mechanistic depth.

result.pairwise_reason: Q015-D provides the broadest, most mechanistically detailed set of 2-hop paths, introduces novel nodes (TMPRSS2/PAR2, NRP1/VWF, NLRP3, STAT1/THBD), and explicitly distinguishes supported from speculative links, offering the highest research value.
